categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in fine chemical new materials, focusing on lithium-ion battery materials and daily chemical materials & specialty chemicals. The lithium-ion battery segment includes electrolytes and cathode materials like lithium iron phosphate, along with upstream raw materials such as lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium carbonate. The daily chemical segment produces surfactants, silicone oils, water-soluble polymers, and cationic conditioners used in personal care and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and purification technologies, including proprietary processes for lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium salts. It has mature production technologies for electrolytes and cathode materials, with ongoing R&D in semi-solid and solid-state electrolytes. Continuous process improvements, patent-protected innovations, and integrated industrial-scale manufacturing underpin its competitive edge. The firm also utilizes recycling and resource recovery technologies for lithium battery materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the new energy vehicle sector, consumer electronics, and energy storage industries for lithium-ion battery materials. The daily chemical products serve personal care brands, household cleaning, and various industrial sectors such as paper, agriculture, and oilfield chemicals. The company has strong relationships with leading domestic and international clients, including multinational corporations in battery and personal care markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with multiple production bases across provinces including Guangdong, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Sichuan, and others. The company has expanded internationally with wholly-owned subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States, Germany, Czech Republic, Singapore, Morocco, and other countries, supporting global market penetration and supply chain integration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tinci operates across the lithium-ion battery materials supply chain, from upstream raw material production (e.g., lithium salts) through midstream electrolyte and cathode material manufacturing to downstream battery recycling and resource recovery. It also supplies specialty chemicals for personal care and industrial applications, positioning itself as an integrated fine chemical materials provider with vertical and horizontal industry chain synergies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance, cost-effective lithium battery materials, including fast-charging electrolytes, high-density cathode materials, and solid-state electrolytes. It invests in resource recycling and sustainable supply chain development. R&D also targets emerging battery technologies like sodium-ion and high-nickel cathodes, alongside expanding specialty chemical product lines. International patent protection and overseas production capacity expansion are key strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products, including lithium-ion battery materials and daily chemical specialty products. The company also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns. Sales are predominantly on a product basis with technical service and solution support enhancing customer value. Hedging activities on raw material prices also impact financial results.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tinci is positioned as a leading domestic and international player in lithium-ion battery materials and fine chemicals. It competes with other major chemical and battery material manufacturers by leveraging integrated supply chain capabilities, advanced technology, and global footprint. Its focus on innovation, cost control, and sustainability strengthens its competitive moat amid intense industry competition and market consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 12.52 billion, a decrease of 18.74% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 484 million, down 74.40%. Despite revenue decline due to market pressures, the company maintains significant scale with diversified product lines and ongoing capacity expansions. R&D investment increased to over RMB 668 million, supporting future growth. The company’s asset base exceeds RMB 11 billion with a stable capital structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tinci emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced chemical materials with strong R&D and patent portfolios. Its vertically integrated supply chain and resource recycling capabilities provide cost and sustainability advantages. The company offers customized solutions and technical support, ensuring product compatibility and performance for customers. Its global production and service network enhance supply reliability and responsiveness, differentiating it in competitive markets.
